title: Exponential convergence can happen in weighted Birkhoff averages via quasi-periodicity with arbitrary nonresonance and low regularity
summary: Since Krengel's work [Kre78] in 1978, it has been widely known that no effective rate of convergence exists in the ergodic theorem. For toral translations, however, by choosing appropriate weights one can accelerate the convergence of ergodic averages to an exponential rate, but this intuitively requires both highly nonresonant frequencies and very regular observables.
